title: Errata for the published PolyForge release (data only; published files unmodified)
measured_from: analysis/v1.5/matrix_cold.json (cold recompute, commit fd0e9eb, lean v4.34.0, mathlib 5ed2965, z3 5.3.1)

published_artifacts.records_319: byte-identical to tag v1.4.5-published-code (1ba72d0); NOT modified by v1.5

defects.what: raw.strip() ate the trailing tab of a zero-axiom PROVEN line, dropping the whole batch to untrusted (UNKNOWN).
defects.measured_impact_on_published_numbers: NONE. This defect was in the v1.4.6 RE-MEASUREMENT/audit stack, after the 319 were generated (generator v1.4.2). It never touched the production of the records. v1.4.6 artifacts are marked SUPERSEDED (superseded.json). Caught now by B3 fuzz + the B4 zero-axiom canary.

defects.where: omega_decide_batch (pre-v1.4.5): inferred PROVEN from the ABSENCE of error messages; maxErrors made later failing goals look proven
defects.what: Unsound 'proven' (a wrong PROVEN can wrongly prune a TRUE theorem).
defects.measured_impact_on_published_numbers: Bounded by the loss attribution. Of a hypothetical complete set, 20 propositions are NOT in the published 319/archive, attributed as OTHER(311-closure)=8, PARAM_BUG=3, REPLACEMENT=9 (matrix_cold.json loss_attribution). The RETAINED 319 are sound: every one of the 231 archived propositions is re-derivable from the final 319 under the correct param-aware COMPLETE (omega) criterion EXCEPT 3 (see next). Fixed in v1.4.6+ (pf_trust.lean_batch never infers success from silence; fail-closed).

defects.where: v1.4.5 usability compared property NAMES only (is_regular(2) treated as discharging is_regular(3))
defects.what: Parameter-blind usability could prune a record/proposition that is NOT actually entailed under the correct parameter-aware criterion.

measured_impact_on_published_numbers.note: MEASURED: 0 of the 319 PUBLISHED RECORDS were pruned on a name-only basis (matrix_cold.json loss_attribution.name_only_pruned_published = 0). The defect's residue is exactly the 3 archived propositions above (the C3 shortfall 231-228=3), which are not re-derivable under the correct param-aware criterion — i.e. they were pruned under the old param-blind rule but should have been kept. Fixed by pf_trust.props (is_regular exact, is_k_edge_connected monotone, arity-guarded).

defects.where: pre-v1.4.7 batch handling (maxErrors abort / orphaned grandchild hang)
defects.what: A hung lake/lean grandchild could block forever; maxErrors could truncate.
defects.measured_impact_on_published_numbers: NONE on the published numbers (a liveness/audit issue). Fixed in v1.4.7 (process-group kill -> UNKNOWN fail-closed) and v1.5 R2 (supervisor).

defects.what: On 6 of 37,582 cold linear-integer queries (29-70 hypotheses, 11 vars) omega returns NOT_PROVEN while z3 proves entailment.
defects.measured_impact_on_published_numbers: NONE. SOUND direction (omega conservative -> at worst keeps a redundant record, never a false PROVEN, never deletes a true theorem; 0 dangerous false-positive candidates). All reported judgments (M1=20, M2=299/299, C3=228/231) match v1.4.7 exactly (per-judgment disagree over the 550 M1+C3 judgments = 0); v1.4.7 used the same omega. Documented in disagreements.json.

net_statement_for_the_paper.published_319: sound and unchanged (byte-identical to 1ba72d0). 20 of the 319 are redundant under the complete param-aware criterion (a minimal basis is 299, both prune orders).
net_statement_for_the_paper.archive_231: 228/231 re-derivable from the final 319 under the correct param-aware COMPLETE criterion; the 3 non-re-derivable ones are the name_only_param_blind_pruning residue listed above.
net_statement_for_the_paper.no_false_theorems: every one of the 4,470 PROVEN omega judgments carries a Lean certificate (axioms ⊆ {propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound}) AND an independent z3 UNSAT confirmation; 0 false positives.
net_statement_for_the_paper.name_only_published: 0 published records were pruned by name-only (parameter-blind) matching.
